system.description:
1 Action, Reach: 8. Remove Soul Touched from an undead minion and choose 1 of the following effects. If Soul Touched wasn’t removed, this does nothing:

  • Ravage. Command all remaining minions to Move 12 and Attack (1d12). Ignores armor.
  • Feast. Command all remaining minions to Move 6 and Attack (1d8). On hit: restore 2 HP for each damage die.

When you would remove Soul Touched from an undead minion, it leaves behind an exploitable corpse. All corpses created this way dissolve after 1 hour.
